items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I had one where I was at a Mahavishnu Orchestra concert with John McLaughlin

ctx.x: loud, and some guy behind me said, “Should I put some restraint on you?” But, and then Monk, how he ended “I Should Care.” Chris Connor’s version of “Driftwood” which nobody seems to play anymore. Abbey’s “Throw It Away,” “Down Here Below”, Mal Waldron “Straight Ahead.”

That’s certainly something for those moments. I had one where I was at a Mahavishnu Orchestra concert with John McLaughlin and Billy Cobham did something on the drums that made me like leap out of my seat. And I’m not prone to do that kind of thing.
